description: What the library offers in one language, to turn a request into filters: the 8 moods (names in that language), the most used tags of that language (most used first) and its collections (title and slug). Call it to narrow find_poems (need, occasion, audience) with one mood and 1–3 tags, or to pick a collection for get_collection. For an easy first poem to learn by heart, find_poems with easy_to_memorise.

language.description: Language of the poems, an ISO 639-1 code: en, ru, be, de, fr, es, it, pl, nl, sv, da, nb or uk. English by default.
